description: Activity (Priority, then Today and Yesterday) and Archive (search, Unarchive) views of your agent chats, with Mark all as read and Clear read chats.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats, to list them.
scopes.workspace:read: Know which workspace is open, to mark its chat.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a chat's workspace when you click it.
scopes.actions:run: Open a chat in a tab.
scopes.storage:local: Remember which chats you archived, read or cleared.
